concern: All 2022 original P2P tests failed after a very small source change, suggesting collection/setup/harness confounding. Distinguish test execution status from independent task correctness and avoid attributing 2022 real regressions without evidence.
diagnostic_scope: Read exact original raw test artifact and determine dominant error type (no module, test collection/setup error vs asserted behavior). Archive bounded counts and short deidentified error indicators, no hidden source or reruns.
claim_limit: The original harness marked unresolved, but the episode cannot be confidently classified as a source-repair failure/success under systemic infrastructure failures until log audit; keep result on original task frame with QC HOLD.
raw_hidden_artifact_license: Do not commit original raw hidden test outputs, exception stack frame source snippets, or third-party binaries to GitHub branch. Only counts and bounded traceback categories.
